questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to cook Indian food at home
Why French food is so popular abroad
How to lose weight after a big meal
All-you-can-eat buffets and how we act
questions.why: Neil says they'll be discussing buffets, where diners eat as much as they want.

questions.q: What happened when Sam went to an Indian buffet?
options: She didn't eat all day, then ate several plates
She didn't like the food
She ate only one small plate
She was too late and the food was gone
questions.why: She didn't eat all day before, and managed three or four plates, maybe five.

questions.q: What criticism of buffets does Sam mention?
options: They are too expensive for families
The food is often cold and tasteless
Too much food is cooked and wasted
They are too small for big groups
questions.why: She says usually too much is cooked, and buffets have been criticised for waste.

questions.q: According to John Wood, why do some people pile their plates high?
options: They are very hungry after a long day
Value for money, or not getting up again
The staff tell them to take a lot at once
They want to share the food with friends
questions.why: He says some don't like getting up and down, and people want value for money.

questions.q: What else does John Wood say expensive-buffet diners do?
options: They take the most expensive items
They eat only salad to stay healthy
They leave early without paying
They try only one or two dishes
questions.why: He says they take the most expensive things they can to get their money's worth.

questions.q: Why does Neil mention Indian weddings?
options: To show that Indians don't like buffets
To explain Indian cooking methods
To show buffets are also used to show off
To say weddings in India are small
questions.why: He says buffets are also a way to show off, and richer couples have bigger buffets.

questions.q: What does caterer Sandeep Sreedharan want guests to say after a wedding?
options: That the food was cheap but tasty
That the wedding was short and fun
That they want the recipe for the curry
That they couldn't eat even half of it
questions.why: He says they should go back saying, 'I couldn't eat even half of it!'

questions.q: Why does Sandeep call it 'a vicious circle'?
options: Because guests always get sick afterwards
Each buffet must beat the last one
Because caterers always lose money on them
Because nobody really enjoys big weddings
questions.why: Neil explains the next buffet always has to be even more impressive.
